title: Root of poetry like all Truth lies in sound The One a beat eternal beat eternal A one the sound the lies, Truth! All like poetry of Root. #smallpoems
summary: Root of poetry like all Truth lies in sound The One a beat eternal beat eternal A one the sound the lies, Truth! All like poetry of Root. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Root of
poetry
like all
Truth
lies
in sound
The One
a beat
eternal

beat
eternal

A one
the sound

the lies,

Truth!

All like
poetry of Root.
#smallpoems
